api_token.description: Forgejo's api token. If not defined, the content of the environment variable `FORGEJO_API_TOKEN` will be used instead.

repo_admin_change_team_access.description: Whether an admin of a repository that belongs to this organization can change team access or not. Defaults to true.

visibility.description: The organization's visibility option: `limited`, `private`, `public`. Defaults to `private`.

block.description: Use this resource to create and manage an organization.

default_branch.description: Name of the default branch. Defaults to "main".

has_actions.description: If true, the actions unit will be enabled. If false, the actions unit will be disabled. If unset, the server default will be left as is.

has_issues.description: If true, the issues unit will be enabled. If false, the issues unit will be disabled. If unset, the server default will be left as is.

has_packages.description: If true, the packages unit will be enabled. If false, the packages unit will be disabled. If unset, the server default will be left as is.

has_projects.description: If true, the projects unit will be enabled. If false, the projects unit will be disabled. If unset, the server default will be left as is.

has_pull_requests.description: If true, the pull requests unit will be enabled. If false, the pull requests unit will be disabled. If unset, the server default will be left as is.

has_releases.description: If true, the releases unit will be enabled. If false, the releases unit will be disabled. If unset, the server default will be left as is.

has_wiki.description: If true, the wiki unit will be enabled. If false, the wiki unit will be disabled. If unset, the server default will be left as is.

owner.description: The name of the organization owning this repository. A null value here means this is a repository belonging to the user whose credentials the provider was instantiated with. Defaults to null.

private.description: If true, the repository is private. Defaults to true.

block.description: Use this resource to create and manage a git repository.

created_at.description: The secret's creation date and time.

name.description: The secret's name. It must be uppercase or the plan will not be idempotent.

block.description: Use this resource to create and manage a repository actions secret.

name.description: The variable's name. It must be uppercase or the plan will not be idempotent.

block.description: Use this resource to create and manage a repository actions variable.

color.description: The label's color in lowercase rgb format, without a leading `#`. For example `207de5`.

exclusive.description: Whether the label is exclusive or not. Defaults to `false`. Name the label `scope/item` to make it mutually exclusive with other `scope/` labels.

id.description: The identifier of the repository label.

is_archived.description: Whether the repository label is archived or not. Defaults to `false`

block.description: Use this resource to create and manage a repository label.

created.description: The push mirror's creation date and time.

interval.description: The push mirror's sync interval as a string. Defaults to `8h0m0s`.

name.description: The name of the push mirror.

owner.description: The owner of the repository on which to configure a push mirror.

repository.description: The repository on which to configure a push mirror.

sync_on_commit.description: Whether the push mirror is synced on each commit pushed to the repository, defaults to `true`.

use_ssh.description: Whether the push mirror is synced over SSH or not (not meaning HTTP), defaults to `false`.

block.description: Use this resource to create and manage a repository push mirror.

can_create_org_repo.description: Whether members of this team can create repositories that will belong to the organization. Defaults to false.

includes_all_repositories.description: Whether members of this team can access all the repositories that belong to the organization. Defaults to false.

organization_name.description: The name of the organization the team is a part of.

permission.description: The members' permission level on the organization. Valid values are `admin`, `read` and `write`.

block.description: Use this resource to create and manage a team.

repo_admin_change_team_access.description: Whether an admin of a repository that belongs to this organization can change team access or not.

visibility.description: The organization's visibility option: limited, private, public.

allow_rebase_update.description: Whether rebase then fast forward merges are allowed or not.

allow_squash_merge.description: Whether squash merge commits are allowed on this repository or not.

archived.description: Whether the repository is archived or not.

default_allow_maintainer_edit.description: Whether maintainers have edit permissions by default or not.

empty.description: Whether the repository is empty or not.

external_tracker_format.description: External issue tracker URL Format. Use the placeholders {user}, {repo} and {index} for the username, repository name and issue index.

external_tracker_regexp_pattern.description: Regular Expression Pattern. The first captured group will be used in place of {index}.

fork.description: Whether the repository is a fork or not.

forks_count.description: The number of times the repository has been forked.

full_name.description: The full name of the repository.

globally_editable_wiki.description: Whether anyone can edit the wiki or not.

allow_only_contributors_to_track_time.description: Whether only contributors are allowed to track time on issues or not.

enable_issue_dependencies.description: Whether issue dependencies are enabled or not.

enable_time_tracker.description: Whether time tracking is enabled or not.

language.description: The main programming language used in the repository.
